🎮 Avatar Studio

Lip sync · expressions · voice changer · recording

The webcam makes your avatar copy your blinks, smiles, eyebrows and head tilt. Without it, the avatar still reacts to your voice by itself.

1. Gameplay video (with your talking)
2. Voice-only audio (optional)
3. Face-cam recording (optional, copies your face)

Files 2 and 3 must start at the same moment as the gameplay video, which they do if OBS recorded them together.

Export plays the video once in real time. Keep this tab open and in front. Press 1–6 during export to change expressions, and they get recorded into the video.

My avatars

Optional but looks much better: the same picture with the mouth closed and eyes closed. Used for real blinking and a natural closed mouth.

Best pictures: facing forward, mouth closed, nothing covering the face, plain background.

Step 2 (optional, looks much better)

In the same AI chat, ask for a second version with the mouth and eyes closed. Then pick your avatar in the Avatar tab and tap Add "mouth & eyes closed" picture.

The app removes the background and finds the eyes, nose and mouth automatically (needs internet). Check the dots, drag any that are off, then press Done.

Recorded videos: record gameplay and commentary in OBS. If you also record your webcam, the avatar can copy your real face. Switch to My recorded video, load the files, pick a voice, then press Export finished video.

Live with OBS: use the green background, press H, and in OBS add a Window Capture of this window plus a Chroma Key filter.

Webcam tracking needs an internet connection the first time, because it downloads Google's free face-tracking model.

Keys: H hide controls · R record (live) · 1–6 expressions. Keys only work while this window is focused.
